note: Example clips for the Przykłady tab. Empty list = the page shows its 'Przykłady w przygotowaniu' empty state. Each entry: {name, file (in this directory), why, durationS, source} — those five fields are what app.js renders; `provenance` is documentation for whoever maintains the demo and is ignored by the page. Files are fetched and decoded by the same code path as an uploaded file, so each ships at its native sample rate and untouched level (no normalisation): playback gain is applied per group at listening time.
